## This repository can't accept pull requests

SetMaster 3 is developed in a private repository and published here as a
generated mirror at each release. There is no path to merge a pull request from
this side, so any PR opened here will be closed unmerged — not because the
change isn't welcome, but because there's nowhere for it to land.

**Please [open an issue](../../issues) instead.** Bug reports and feature
requests are read and acted on, and a fix will show up in the next published
release. If you've already written a patch, describing it in the issue (or
linking your fork) is the fastest way to get it incorporated.
